title: Killers of the Flower Moon
author: David Grann
summary: In 1920s Oklahoma, members of the oil-rich Osage Nation were killed one after another. David Grann follows the early FBI investigation and the wider conspiracy that official inquiries left untouched.
readIf: you want a well-reported American true-crime history with a lasting injustice at its centre.
skipIf: you want a neat mystery, since the story is bleak and its outcome incomplete.
